one: Safe and constrained AI: constrained optimization, safe RL, projection networks, and LLM alignment.
pos: MS&E 318 is a PhD-level seminar on making AI systems not only powerful but provably safe. It covers classical constrained optimization, safe RL (trust regions, Lyapunov, reachability, shielding), hybrid ML/optimization (projection networks, solver-in-the-loop), and LLM alignment, with applications in robotics, finance, healthcare, and energy.
topics: **Safe RL**: trust regions, Lyapunov, reachability, shielding
**LLM alignment**: fine-tuning, model editing, tool use, interactive alignment
prereq: Optimization at the CME 307 or EE 364A level.
assess: Paper discussion plus a final project. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Graduate students in safe RL, control, optimization, or alignment; people who want AI with guarantees.
tips: Brush up on convex optimization and control theory first. The course is theoretical; pick a project where safety can be proven or measured.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing.
